keyPoints.en: Packaging protects, preserves, informs, promotes and helps transport and storage.
keyPoints.bm: Pembungkusan melindungi, mengawet, memberi maklumat, mempromosi dan membantu pengangkutan serta penyimpanan.

keyPoints.en: Choose recyclable, right-sized packaging with minimal plastic.
keyPoints.bm: Pilih pembungkusan boleh dikitar semula, bersaiz sesuai dengan plastik minimum.

keyPoints.en: A net folds into a 3D package; add tabs, score fold lines, test with scrap paper first.
keyPoints.bm: Bentangan dilipat menjadi bungkusan 3D; tambah tab, garis lipatan, uji dengan kertas buangan dahulu.

keyPoints.en: Labels: product name, ingredients, net weight, expiry date, manufacturer, barcode.
keyPoints.bm: Label: nama produk, ramuan, berat bersih, tarikh luput, pengilang, kod bar.

keyPoints.en: Total cost = materials + labour + overheads. Selling price = cost + profit.
keyPoints.bm: Jumlah kos = bahan + upah + overhed. Harga jualan = kos + untung.

keyPoints.en: Profit % = (price − cost) ÷ cost × 100. Example: RM9.00 + 20% = RM10.80.
keyPoints.bm: Peratus untung = (harga − kos) ÷ kos × 100. Contoh: RM9.00 + 20% = RM10.80.
